rounds.q: What % of all trips in the Netherlands are made by bicycle?
rounds.why: Cycling bounced back in 2022 to its usual pre-pandemic share.

rounds.q: How many million bicycles do the Dutch own?
rounds.why: That's more bikes than people: the Netherlands has about 17 million residents.

rounds.q: How many million flights did the world's airlines fly in 2024?
rounds.why: That year there was one accident of any kind per 880,000 flights.

rounds.q: How many minutes is the average US worker's one-way commute?
rounds.why: About 1 in 11 US workers spends over an hour getting to work each way.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (2024)

rounds.q: What % of US workers drive to work alone?
rounds.why: Only 3.7% take public transit, fewer than the 13% who work from home.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (2024)
